\section{Setup}
This paper runs each program three times on one GPU with 256\,MiB of copy buffer.
Each run has a 10 s limit, and 80\% of runs finish within 2.5 s.
The median success rate is 8.26\% over all jobs; Table 2 repeats 8.26 per group.
